title: Canonical proper pushforward comparison is an isomorphism on limit sheaves
statement: Let Y be Noetherian, J a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, f:X\to Y proper, F coherent on X, and assume H=f_*F is coherent [def-weil-proper-morphism, pqf-def-coherent]. Let κ:H^\wedge\to(f_*(F/(J\mathcal O_X)^{n+1}F))_n be a morphism of inverse systems such that π^J_n κ_n=f_*(π^{J\mathcal O_X}_n) for every n\ge0 [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Then the induced map between the inverse limits, taken in the category of O_Y-module sheaves, is an isomorphism. No object G, map γ, or lifting conclusion is involved.

source.place: Theorem 02OC, degree zero, and first half of Lemma 088B; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OC and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088B

proof.text: For each affine open U apply formalCompletion_pushforward_limit_app_bijective with the supplied J, f, F, coherence of H, κ and hκ.

Apply the existing upstream Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_app_of_isAffineOpen (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.LocallyFreeAffine) to lim.map κ. Its hypothesis is precisely the preceding affine-section bijectivity; this supplies the sheaf-gluing step.

lean.statement:
theorem formalCompletion_pushforward_limit_isIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (F : CoherentModules X)
    (h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj))
    (κ : formalCompletionSystem J ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ⟶
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (hκ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ≫
        κ.app (op n) = (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap f) (n + 1) F.obj)) :
    IsIso (lim.map κ)
